overviewZh: 从零学习用 C 语言解决问题：在 Linux 环境中写程序、编译、运行、测试和 debug。

weeks.title: Linux, first C programs, variables and constants
weeks.summaryZh: VLab/Linux/terminal 入门；写、编译和运行第一份 C 程序；变量、int/double/char、printf、scanf、算术和常量。
weeks.note: Official Week 1 PDFs are public official teaching materials, but this public app stores only a compact private-study summary.
